## What changes and why / Ինչ ա փոխվում ու ինչու

## How it was checked / Ոնց ա ստուգվել

- [ ] the commands I ran and their real output are listed here (not "should pass")
- [ ] no secret, token, password, database, live log or personal material is in the diff
- [ ] `site/` still equals what is deployed, or this change is a deliberate site release
- [ ] `runtime/server/` was not edited by hand (it is a record of the server)
- [ ] commits are authored and committed as MenQ, with no co-author or tool lines

## What is not verified / Ինչը ստուգված չի

## Needs the owner's yes / Պետք ա Գևի «հա»-ն

Anything public, paid, sent to a person, or changed on the server is named here, with the exact text or amount.
